title: Don't be a meat proxy
summary: This article discusses the concept of avoiding being a 'meat proxy' - a human intermediary who performs tasks that could be automated or handled by systems. The author explores how many knowledge workers spend their time as unnecessary middlemen, routing information or approvals that don't require human judgment, and encourages readers to identify and eliminate these bottlenecks in their workflows.
problem_solved: Addresses the problem of humans unnecessarily acting as intermediaries in processes that could be automated or streamlined.
why_valuable: It challenges readers to critically examine their daily workflows and identify opportunities to eliminate human bottlenecks, potentially freeing up time for more meaningful work.
